description: This Dart file defines a Flutter widget, specifically the main screen (ReactAgentScreen) for the ReAct Agent app. It manages user input, displays conversation steps, and controls the agent's activity state.

classes.name: ReactAgentScreen
classes.description: The main screen widget of the ReAct Agent app, providing input UI, display of steps, and interaction with the controller.
